question: Which city hosted the 38th National Games from 28 January to 14 February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dehradun**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **38th National Games** were hosted by the state of **Uttarakhand**, with **Dehradun** serving as the primary host city and central hub for the majority of the sporting events.
 
• The games were scheduled to be held from **28 January to 14 February 2025**, a timeline finalized by the **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** in coordination with the state government.
 
• This event marks the first time that **Uttarakhand** has hosted the National Games, highlighting the state's growing sports infrastructure and its capability to organize multi-sport events of national importance.
 
• The **Indian Olympic Association**, led by its President **P.T. Usha**, officially approved the venues and the schedule after reviewing the readiness of the sports complexes in the state.
 
• The official mascot for the **38th National Games** is the **Himalayan Monal**, which is also the state bird of **Uttarakhand**, symbolizing the rich natural heritage and high-altitude spirit of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History of National Games**: 
 
 
• The National Games of India were first held in **1924** in **Lahore** (in undivided India) as the **Indian Olympic Games**.
 
• The event was renamed the **National Games** in **1940** during the **Bombay** edition to better reflect its national character.
 
 
 
• **Previous Edition**: 
 
 
• The **37th National Games** were hosted by **Goa** in **2023**, specifically from **October 25 to November 9**.
 
• In the **37th edition**, the state of **Maharashtra** emerged as the champion, winning the **Raja Bhalindra Singh Trophy** for the best-performing team.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure and Venues**: 
 
 
• To accommodate the **38th National Games**, infrastructure was developed across several clusters, including **Haldwani**, **Rishikesh**, **Nainital**, and **Rudrapur**, in addition to **Dehradun**.
 
• Key venues in **Dehradun** include the **Maharana Pratap Sports College** and the **Raipur Sports Complex**, which underwent significant upgrades for various indoor and outdoor disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Significance**: 
 
 
• The National Games serve as a critical scouting ground for the **Olympics** and **Asian Games**, allowing the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** to identify top-tier talent across **38 or more sporting disciplines**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Organizing Body**: The **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** is the apex body responsible for selecting the host state and supervising the technical conduct of the games.
 
• **State Participation**: Athletes from all **28 states** and **8 Union Territories**, as well as the **Services Sports Control Board (SSCB)**, participate in this biennial event.
 
• **Economic Impact**: Hosting the **38th National Games** in **2025** was expected to provide a major boost to **Uttarakhand’s tourism industry** and generate employment through the development of sports tourism.
 
• **Sports Policy**: The event aligns with the **"Khelo India"** vision to create a vibrant sports culture and provides **Uttarakhand** an opportunity to showcase its hospitality to thousands of visiting athletes and officials.
